rules.completion: status=completed AND completed=steps AND steps>0; failed prefixes excluded from all rankings and figures
rules.reference: RMS comparisons require reference_valid=1; certified by paired reference resolutions in study.cpp
rules.residuals: independent solver pass: max_balance<=1e-6 and max_rx<=1e-5; rods additionally length<=1e-6 and requested tangency<=1e-5; completed does not imply this pass
rules.pareto: position RMS, velocity RMS, maximum relative energy error, absolute log(path ratio); floors 1e-8,1e-7,1e-10,1e-6 respectively
rules.balanced_score: max(position RMS/0.01 m, energy error/0.01, absolute log(path ratio)/0.1); illustrative disclosed scales, used only within identical physical cohorts
rules.nearly_frozen: path_ratio<0.1; diagnostic, not a visual-quality assessment
rules.xpbd_comparator: complete/certified XPBD with smallest position RMS in the same case,hz,duration,stiffness,mass-ratio,perturbation cohort
rules.candidate_gate: complete/certified; position and velocity RMS <=1.05x matched XPBD; log-path error <=max(0.01,1.05x baseline); energy <=max(1e-8,1.05x baseline); either position or energy improves at least20%; path ratio>=0.1; residual pass is reported separately
rules.timing: compute-only, parallel-contention affected; relative timings are diagnostic until a serial benchmark
rules.aliases: explicit free/global-energy aliases deduplicated; ignored hard-endpoint beta and non-rigid tangency deduplicated
rules.pending: manifest jobs without a CSV record are pending, not failed executions
